narration: In month {fork_month}, after {identical_months} months that matched, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. In month {crossover_month}, the lead between the two lives changed hands. The ghost's Safety ended {safety_gap}, and it could last less long with no pay. The ghost's Freedom ended {freedom_gap}, and more of its pay was committed before each month began. By month {end_month}, the ghost had {net_worth_gap}.
